title: Tag link (NFC/QR tag)
description: URL written on an NFC tag (NDEF URI record) or printed as QR code. Fixed because it stays on physical tags: https://<website>/t/<tag_id>, development form <scheme>://t/<tag_id>. No query, no fragment, no secret. The website path is claimed by the apps (apple-app-site-association applinks and Android App Links in assetlinks.json); without the app the website shows a short page. The app resolves the id at its hub (tag_resolve); what a tag does is stored in the hub (docs/links.md).
x-client-rules: Only the brand website (brand.json urls.website) or the app scheme, path /t/ followed by exactly 22 base64url characters; anything else is ignored (no aliases, no other paths).
The app never acts on the URL alone: it sends tag_resolve to the hub of the active home; on unknown_tag it asks its other homes, then shows “Tag not set up”.
Switching runs like a widget (control_origin quick_access), only after tag_result ok, and only with Pro and the rule scan_tags.
Without a hub connection (away) the app shows the tag name only if it knows it from an earlier scan and does nothing else.
